metadata.title: About Us - SellifyWorks
metadata.description: SellifyWorks is the Shopify agency for small and medium stores the big agencies ignore. Enterprise process, your stage's price.

hero.title: An agency for the stores the big players ignore.
hero.subtitle: We don't compete for brands that already have an enterprise budget. We built SellifyWorks for the ones that don't, yet.

why.title: Big agencies don't pick up the phone for an 800-conversion-a-month store.
why.p1: The agencies that actually deliver charge like you're a nine-figure brand. The cheap ones treat your store like one more project on a list of a hundred. Neither one looks closely.
why.p2: SellifyWorks exists for the middle: enterprise-grade process — audits, conversion research, automation — at the price and pace of a store that's still growing.

outcomes.title: Outcomes, not hours
outcomes.content: We charge for what we deliver, not for how long it takes us to deliver it.

data.title: Data, not opinions
data.content: Every recommendation comes from real numbers — Analytics, research, testing — not from what "looks better".

honesty.title: Honest about scope
honesty.content: If a task doesn't fit your plan, we tell you before charging you, not after.

mathias.description: Software engineer with 10+ years of experience. Designs and builds every SellifyWorks project end to end.

cta.title: Does your store fit this profile?
cta.subtitle: If you're below the radar of the big agencies, let's talk.
